description: This file provides support functions for switching and initializing web editors such as CKEditor and TinyMCE within the TestLink project. It defines functions to determine the editor type and configure editor instances dynamically.

classes.name: ckeditorInterface
classes.description: Class for interfacing with CKEditor, configuring its path and settings.

classes.name: tinymce
classes.description: Class for managing TinyMCE editor instances and configurations.

classes.name: no_editor
classes.description: Class for representing a disabled or no-op editor interface.

methods.name: require_web_editor
methods.description: Determines the required editor class filename based on editor type or configuration.

methods.name: web_editor
methods.description: Initializes and returns an editor instance configured according to the given parameters and project settings.
